title: SearchQueryBundle
description: Output contract for 100x-search-query. Self-contained in this skill (this repo has no shared cross-skill schemas/ yet, so this file is the single source of truth for its own output). One product/persona in -> Pinterest/TikTok/Reddit search-phrase bundle out. NOTE: vanilla JSON Schema draft-07 can enforce per-item shape (bucket size, q ASCII pattern, intent_cn format, stage enum) but CANNOT enforce cross-item aggregates -- axiom 2's per-bucket keyword-density thresholds and axiom 3's 'must cover >=3 of the 5 stages' rule. A document with all 45 items validly stage:'Advocate' passes this schema but violates axiom 3. Those aggregate checks are enforced by the real, runnable script at scripts/validate.js, which loads this file at runtime and reuses its stage enum + intent_cn pattern so the two never drift apart. See axioms.md for the split.

product_name.description: Echo of the input product/persona name. Must not be a real customer/brand identifier when used in this repo's evals/ (synthetic only).

category.description: Generic taxonomy category (e.g. 保健品/家居/美妆个护/3C/通用), never a customer-specific category dictionary entry.

source_language_note.description: Optional. Notes the language of the source product copy when it isn't English (e.g. 'source copy: es'). Does not change output language -- see axioms.md #1.

based_on_5a.description: Dominant 5A stage(s) this run leaned on, e.g. 'Ask+Aware'. Must never be empty.

warnings.description: Non-fatal flags, e.g. a query that failed an axiom 3x and was kept as best-effort (axioms.md workflow rework rule).

persona_informed.description: Whether Phase 1 category-C persona/insight input was provided for this run. When true, axiom 5 (scripts/validate.js) requires persona_descriptor_terms to be non-empty and >=6 of the 45 queries to demonstrably reflect it. Omit or set false when no persona/insight input was given -- axiom 5 does not apply then.

persona_descriptor_terms.description: Specific audience/identity descriptor terms drawn from the persona/insight card's identity_label/audience_fit/delivery_style (or equivalent fields), self-reported by whichever agent ran this skill. Used by scripts/validate.js to mechanically check persona-informed query coverage. Required non-empty when persona_informed is true.

q.description: Search phrase. ASCII only (axiom 1) -- hashtags and digits allowed, no CJK.

intent_cn.pattern: ^(共鸣|决策前|决策|叙事|场景灵感|场景|对比|情绪认同|情绪|方法求解|求助|求推荐|泛用|生活方式|痛点|种草|视觉参考|购买前|购买后|身份认同|陈列|预期管理|风险确认|验证|质疑):[一-龥，、/0-9]+$
intent_cn.description: Chinese search-intent annotation, <=20 chars. Axiom 4: must be 'closed-set intent-category label + colon + Chinese-only elaboration' -- pattern enforces this FORMAT by construction, without needing an EN-CN dictionary. Known limitation: this only enforces format, not semantics -- a label-wrapped literal translation (e.g. q:'does this supplement actually work' + intent_cn:'质疑:这个补剂真的有效吗') passes the pattern while still being a word-for-word translation. See axioms.md #4 for the semantic-overlap check and its design rationale.
